metadata.title: DPWH Infrastructure Projects — Puerto Princesa City
metadata.description: Roads, bridges, buildings, flood control, and water system projects located within Puerto Princesa City, implemented by DPWH Palawan District Engineering Offices.
metadata.note: Filtered to projects whose description explicitly names "Puerto Princesa City"; excludes projects that merely pass through the city along corridors named after it (e.g. Puerto Princesa North/South Road) but are physically located in other municipalities. Only the 5 highest-cost projects per category are itemized below; category totals reflect all matching projects, including ones still at the procurement stage with no awarded contract cost yet.
